;Business and economy
*German airline [[Lufthansa]] resumes flights between [[Cairo]] and [[Frankfurt]] and [[Munich]], while [[British Airways]] flights to Cairo remain cancelled for six more days. The [[UK Foreign Office]] warns against "all travel" to certain parts of [[Egypt]], but its standard advice for Cairo is for passengers to check for changes. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-49062050 (BBC News)] [https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/egypt (UK Foreign Office)]

;International relations
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Venezuelan military]] reports that on Friday, an American Naval reconnaissance plane entered its national airspace, threatening flights to [[Maiquetia Airport]]; the United States asserts that their aircraft was over international waters in the Caribbean on an approved mission. The US plane was followed for a prolonged time by a Venezuelan fighter. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-07-20/venezuela-claims-u-s-military-aircraft-violated-its-airspace (Bloomberg)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/21/us-military-venezuelan-plane-aggressively-shadowed-navy-aircraft (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Argentina]]
**[[President of Argentina|President]] [[Mauricio Macri]] and [[Ministry of Justice and Human Rights (Argentina)|Justice and Human Rights Minister]] of Argentina [[Germán Garavano]] say that Argentina will start to receive reports of human rights abuses and criminal accusations against the [[Venezuelan government]]. Macri also reiterates his support for [[Juan Guaidó]]. [https://tn.com.ar/politica/el-gobierno-redobla-la-presion-sobre-maduro-y-tomara-denuncias-por-violaciones-de-derechos-humanos_980032 (TN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Customs Administration, Ministry of Finance|Taiwan Customs]] officers discover 9800 cartons of cigarettes worth more than 200,000 USD smuggled in five trucks of presidential motorade when [[President of Republic of China|President]] [[Tsai Ing-wen]] has returned from an official trip to the [[Caribbean]] and leaves the airport via a VIP lane. A security agent of [[National Security Bureau (Taiwan)|National Security Bureau]] within Tsai's entourage allegedly pre-ordered the cigarettes duty-free from [[China Airlines]] and stored them at a warehouse of the airline's catering company at [[Taoyuan International Airport]]. National Security Bureau Director-General [[Peng Sheng-chu]] resigns over the scandal on the following day. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3750072 (''Taiwan News'')] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/taiwan-s-intelligence-chief-resigns-over-smuggled-cigarettes-11746742 (CNA)][http://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2019/07/24/2003719210 (''Taipei Times'')]
*[[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests]]
**A mob of suspected masked [[Triad (organized crime)|triad]] members dressed in white and armed with batons [[2019 Yuen Long violence|attack commuters indiscriminately]] at [[Yuen Long station]], injuring 45, including a pro-democracy legislator and a pregnant woman. [[Hong Kong Police Force|Hong Kong police]] have been accused of allowing the violence to happen due to their delayed response and decision to limit emergency services in the area. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/22/where-were-the-police-hong-kong-outcry-after-masked-thugs-launch-attack (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3019524/least-10-injured-baton-wielding-mob-suspected-triad (''SCMP'')]
**[[Pro-Beijing camp (Hong Kong)|Pro-Beijing]] legislator [[Junius Ho]] applauds the assailants for their actions, saying they should be "pardoned for defending their homes" and calling them his "heroes". [https://www.hongkongfp.com/2019/07/22/just-chaos-bloodshed-hong-kong-district-hundreds-masked-men-assault-protesters-journalists-residents/ (HKFP)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/3019621/pro-beijing-lawmaker-junius-ho-defends-white-clad-mob (''SCMP'')]
*A former Venezuelan state oil executive at [[PDVSA]], [[Juan Carlos Márquez]], is found hanged in an apartment in [[Madrid]]. He had been taken into custody in connection with an investigation into corruption and money laundering. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49082596 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Japanese House of Councillors election]]
**[[Japan|Japanese]] citizens head to the polls to elect one half of the members of the country's [[House of Councillors (Japan)|House of Councillors]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/07/21/national/politics-diplomacy/abes-quest-amend-constitution-crossroads-voting-begins-japans-upper-house-election/#.XTRzNkHgqUk (''Japan Times'')]
**The [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|Liberal Democratic Party of Japan]], led by [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]], wins a clear, but reduced, majority of the seats but falls short on gaining the two-thirds [[supermajority]] needed to start the pursued process of amending the [[Constitution of Japan|constitution]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-japan-election-takeaways/takeaways-from-japan-poll-diplomatic-challenges-and-diversity-idUKKCN1UH0CE (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Ukrainian parliamentary election]]
**[[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] citizens vote for the new members of the [[Verkhovna Rada]], following its dissolution by [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelensky]] in May. [https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-parliamentary-vote-fresh-start-or-a-u-turn/a-49658313 (DW)] 
**[[Servant of the People (political party)|Servant of the People]], President Zelensky’s party, wins most of the seats with a comfortable majority. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/22/ukraine-election-early-results-indicate-big-win-president-party (''The Guardian'')] 

;Sports
*[[2019 Open Championship]]
**In [[golf]], [[Shane Lowry (golfer)|Shane Lowry]] of [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] wins the year's final [[Men's major golf championships|men's major]] at [[Royal Portrush Golf Club|Portrush, Northern Ireland]] by 6 shots over [[England]]'s [[Tommy Fleetwood]]. [https://www.espn.com/golf/story/_/id/27234247/ireland-lowry-breezes-victory-open (ESPN)]
